questions.prompt: Thick value is a hand that…

choices.text: Beats most of the hands that will call a large bet, such as a set or the nuts.

questions.explanation: Bet large when worse hands still call and better hands are rare.

questions.prompt: Thin value is a hand that…

choices.text: Beats some worse calls but loses to a lot of the continuing range.
Must be all-in or it is not value

questions.explanation: Thin value uses a smaller size, and only against opponents who call too wide.

choices.text: You bet for value and fold if they raise, because their raise beats you.
You bet and must call any raise

questions.explanation: A value bet is not a decision to stack off. If you would hate a raise, plan to fold to it.

questions.prompt: Against a nit who only calls the river with better, thin value…

choices.text: Becomes a check. They do not pay you with worse.

questions.explanation: Value needs worse hands to call. A nit removes those calls.
